label: VLM-driven retrieval
description: Replace structured access with a VLM decision at each proposed subgoal.

label: No live tracking
description: Remove online tracking of object-to-container bindings.

label: No demonstration following
description: Remove updates that follow demonstrated identities during execution.

label: No demonstration notes
description: Remove memory notes established from the demonstration.

label: No demonstration references
description: Remove historical references used to identify demonstrated targets.

label: No route memory
description: Remove stored routes and ordered procedural state.

label: Refine every subgoal
description: Enable refinement for every verb instead of selective access.

label: Source from received frames
description: Use the received-frame source instead of the agent-selected source.

label: Single-vote write plan
description: Use one write-plan vote; the independent reader compiler retains three votes.
